result.note: Mostly a misinformation rebuttal; one statements question on the factual clarifications about E20 fuel-grade ethanol and insurance.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited issued clarifications about E20 ethanol-blended petrol. Consider the following statements:
items: Fuel-grade ethanol used for blending is distilled to eliminate residual sugars and contains insect-repellent denaturants.
Industry stakeholders found that using E20 petrol voids vehicle insurance coverage.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: BPCL said fuel-grade ethanol is distilled to remove residual sugars and carries insect-repellent denaturants, while the ministry said industry stakeholders had found the insurance claim to be incorrect. The E20 programme is a cornerstone of India's push to cut crude oil imports and support domestic agriculture.
questions.source: fuel-grade ethanol is distilled to eliminate residual sugars and contains insect-repellent denaturants
